summary: English and Portuguese first-party discovery identified the official municipal Geoportal/DiviGeo and Cadastro Imobiliário. The public downloads API returned cadastral-map documentation, while the current interactive-map configuration endpoint redirected anonymously to a GeoWise login. No safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was qualified and no sample was retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries, URLs, viewer configuration inspection, endpoint checks, response outcomes, schema/CRS checks, safe field allowlist, scope limits, and uncertainty are recorded in city-7685-divin-polis.json. No login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, credentials, private tokens, TLS bypass, or unsafe-field request occurred.

custodians.name: Prefeitura de Divinópolis — Cadastro Imobiliário / Geoportal (DiviGeo)
custodians.scope: Local municipal cadastral and territorial-management custodian, evidenced by official municipal geoprocessing and cadastral-map materials.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native cadastral parcel identifier only if source-proven
full parcel polygon geometry only when safely returned
scopeLimits: The exact WUP point and population are preserved in the city record.
The login-wall outcome is an access/qualification result, not evidence of parcel absence.
No anonymous ID-plus-geometry response, parcel schema, CRS, or citywide vector coverage was qualified.
No unsafe land-record fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission.
uncertainty: Authenticated GeoWise configuration may expose WMS/WFS sources that were not available anonymously.
No independent runtime adapter qualification was performed.
